---
title: "Ablation Matrix"
---

## What an ablation matrix tests

The ablation matrix isolates the contribution of each strategy component (halts, vol-regime gate, ML stack) by running the same backtest with that component turned off. The result tells us:

- Which component is doing the actual work
- Whether removing a component is harmful or harmless
- Whether components stack (full > sum of parts) or cancel (full < sum of parts)

## The 6 modes

| Mode | Halts | Vol regime gate | ML (Head 1+3 + Head 2 scaler) |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| **naked** | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ |
| **halts_only** | ✓ | ✗ | ✗ |
| **vol-regime-only** | ✗ | ✓ | ✗ |
| **ml_only** | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ |
| **regime+halts** | ✓ | ✓ | ✗ |
| **full** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

## Multiple-testing correction (DSR over the 6-mode N)
